text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...How about this, then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, that won't work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer and I pass by the
shopping mall on
our way back from an
outing and spot an unusual
pair looking
quite troubled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hi, hiii! Whatcha two up to? Ooh, you
must be
looking for a present for
someone if you're
hanging out by the
gift section!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Wh-what do you want?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
To help, I guess. You two look like
you're in a
pickle, so I thought I'd lend a
hand. I keep up with
all trends, so
whaddya think? Want my help?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, please. I'm getting a headache
trying to
think of something good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aww! So you both wanted to get
Hayahide a lil'
something to celebrate
her setting a new personal
best...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And you bumped into each other
because you
were thinking the same
thing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The last thing we want is to get her the
same gift,
so we figured it'd be easier to
buy something
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For starters, can you both tell me what
you were
planning to get?
choice_data_list: 意見が合わなくて難航していた、と

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She likes bananas, so that's obviously
the best
gift.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, going with what she likes is always
a good
idea! So, what's the issue?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Now's "not the time," apparently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh! I guess she's not really focusing
on
bulking, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
She's prolly in peak form right now since
she just
got a PB, so it'd be pretty sucky
if she bulked up
too much and got
thrown off her groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're so considerate, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
N-no! I just don't want her to waste her
potential!
As long as the thought comes
across, that'll be
enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I thought that black outfit'd be
nice...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I agree! It's so chic and mature. I
bet it'd
look great on Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's supposed to be a celebratory gift,
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Guess you'd wanna get her
something
brighter since we're trying to
party things up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But you can't object because there
aren't any
other good gift options, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Here I thought we couldn't agree on
something
'cause of our different tastes,
but now I see it's a
little more complex...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer keeps talking with them
until they
finally find common ground.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your purchase!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew! All done! Hayahide'll love it,
guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... She'll get plenty of use out of it,
but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It still feels too generic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I think it's a perfectly fine gift. I mean,
you both
put so much thought into
picking something just
for her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's been raving about this hair
product
because of how effective it is,
and it doesn't
affect race performance at
all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure all your feelings will come
through loud
and clear when you give
this to her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, it sure feels good to help people
out! All's
well that ends well, amirite?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Nah, I hardly did anything.

They both wanted the same thing from
the start,
and that was to make

Our conversation stays just as lively all
